# Contributing to malaysiatax

Thank you for your interest in improving this repository!

## How to contribute
1. Fork the repository.
2. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-topic`
3. Add or update content in the appropriate folder.
4. If adding data, include the source/link and the date of the data.
5. Commit changes and open a PR.

## Content rules
- Prefer official sources (LHDN, MOF, Bank Negara, official gazettes). Cite them.
- When submitting calculators, include example inputs & expected outputs.
- Label country/region and year for all rate tables.

If you're unsure, open an issue first to discuss the change.
